kind: measurement of a build option; evidence for a decision, not an acceptance test
question: What changes when the build links BAFU's elementary flows through Brightway Flows, with the links of patch 0010, in place of the mapping of sentier-mappings?
design: BAFU:2026 v1 as the installer reads it (11,947 datasets, 293,747 elementary exchanges, 2,679 flows), built twice with only the linking changed and scored in the 25 EF 3.1 categories of the build's methods (sentier-methods, factors without a location). Linking one: sentier-mappings at 179aab3. Linking two: the crosswalk patch 0010 uses, with brightway-flows-targets-bafu-2026-v1.csv (Brightway Flows 1.1.0, https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23554066): an amount is converted only where that release states the conversion; a flow outside EF 3.1 takes the build's factors of the one EF 3.1 flow that Brightway Flows' own implementation of EF 3.1 names as their source; no factor is read from Brightway Flows. A dataset moves when its score differs by more than 1 % of the larger of the two.
reproduce: uv run --frozen --project brightway-installer --python 3.12 --extra testing python scripts/compare_flow_linkings.py --work output/linkings --out comparison.json

sentier-mappings: Linked 2566/2679 bafu-2026 flows to EF 3.1 (95.8%); 284443/293747 biosphere exchanges (96.8%)
518 of the linked flows point at EF flows with no factor (nomenclature only, impact zero)
Unlinked flows kept in bafu-2026-residual (no EF 3.1 counterpart in the bridge):
brightway-flows: Linked through Brightway Flows (the links of patch 0010): 2677/2679 flows
1993 to a flow of EF 3.1; 684 to a flow outside EF 3.1, of which 331 take the factors of the EF 3.1 flow Brightway Flows names
192 linked with a conversion the release states
785 of the linked flows have no factor in any method (impact zero)
2 not linked: the units differ and the release states no conversion (for example Gas, mine, off-gas, process, coal mining/m3 (m3 to sm3); Gas, mine, off-gas, process, coal mining/m3 (Nm3 to sm3))

why_a_factor_is_lost.why: outside EF 3.1, and Brightway Flows names no flow as the source of factors
the EF 3.1 flow named as the source of its factors has none in the build's methods (Brightway Flows: adopted)
the EF 3.1 flow named as the source of its factors has none in the build's methods (Brightway Flows: restated)
its EF 3.1 flow has no factor in the build's methods
not linked: the units differ and no conversion is stated
Brightway Flows names more than one flow as the source of its factors
the EF 3.1 flow named as the source of its factors has none in the build's methods (Brightway Flows: carried)

findings: The links reach more flows (2,677 of 2,679 against 2,566), and every conversion they need is stated by Brightway Flows 1.1.0 (192).
Fewer flows end on a factor: 166 flows (14,278 exchanges, 4.9 % of all) have a factor through the mapping and none through the links; 9 gain one.

Those 166 are in most supply chains: 11,801 of 11,947 datasets move by more than 1 % in at least one category, nearly all downwards. Particulate matter, freshwater eutrophication, ecotoxicity and land use move for more than 10,000 datasets each.
Acidification, terrestrial eutrophication and the biogenic and land-use parts of climate change do not move for any dataset. Climate change moves for 20.

92 of the 166 are flows outside EF 3.1 for which Brightway Flows names no flow as the source of factors (BAFU's land classes among them). 56 have a named source that has no factor in the build's methods, where Brightway Flows' own implementation adopts or restates one. 14 end on an EF 3.1 flow without a factor in the build's methods.
limits: Says what differs, not which linking is right flow by flow. The classification of the differing flows is a separate piece of work.
The build's methods are the reference for factors. With Brightway Flows' own factors the result would differ; that was not measured here.
Measured on BAFU's release as shipped. The patched copy links on the flows BAFU declared, so its flows are the same.
The exports for LCA tools and the comparison of two builds were not run with the second linking.
